E1 establishes failure of that outcome even though the root/alias/routing cause is unknown. Mark the outcome FALLA and retain implementation details as unverified, or split the control. suggestions.reason: Add semantic status checks alongside structure and arithmetic: FILE-01 incorrectly remains NO VERIFICADO even though its expected public-only serving outcome is contradicted by E1. Unknown root cause must not erase an observed failure. The existing assertion passes despite this substantive inconsistency.

Explicitly verify checklist completeness, parent/subcontrol uniqueness, status totals, pending-table coverage and finding deduplication. All those mechanical checks pass here, but passing arithmetic alone does not establish correct classification.

suggestions.assertion: El informe es coherente con una simulación offline y no inventa datos técnicos observados o resultados de comandos.
suggestions.reason: Artifact consistency can be graded, but the report's claims about resource reads, commands and network abstention require an execution transcript. Avoid interpreting this pass as independent confirmation of process history.

eval_feedback.overall: 7/7 supplied assertions pass. All 34 checklist IDs are represented, numerical summaries and pending coverage match, and three findings correctly map to four failed rows as written. FILE-01 nevertheless understates a confirmed outcome failure; the assertions do not directly test that semantic error.
